parsed.explanation: For adult trans visitors (21+) the dossier documents no presentation offence, no facility/bathroom rule, no border or document friction, no police targeting and no custody-placement mandate; the 2025 care ban's protected class is under-21 and its operative clause targets providers. That places adults in the elevated band rather than a universal-exposure tier. Two real deductions: (1) the under-21 subset carries a traveller-facing exposure — hormones sit inside the statute's literal definition, so the risk is harassment-shaped (questioning, investigation, detention) with no test case resolving it, and accompanying parents are exposed; (2) the 2013 anti-discrimination law covers employment only, leaving service refusals without recourse, alongside a documented 2020–2021 pattern of murders, assault and rape of trans women. Offsetting that pattern: gender-identity hate-crime coverage since 2002, charges actually brought in 2020, and a governor's emergency declaration. Stalled conversion-therapy and religious-refusal bills signal contested rather than uniformly hostile institutions. Rated below the 0.55 anchors because the violence record is lethal and accommodation recourse is absent, above the 0.35 anchors because no universal exclusion or police coercion applies to adult visitors.
